# Scope: the studying character. Resolve the work the numeric ID names.
kehillah_study_torah_resolve_current_work_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 1 }
		kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_targum_onkelos TRACK = parshanut KEY = work_targum_onkelos }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 2 }
		kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_mekhilta TRACK = parshanut KEY = work_mekhilta }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 3 }
		kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_genesis_rabbah TRACK = parshanut KEY = work_genesis_rabbah }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 4 }

			kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_authored_20 TRACK = parshanut KEY = work_authored_20 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 64 }
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_21 = 2 }
			kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_authored_21 TRACK = talmudics KEY = work_authored_21 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_21 = 3 }
			kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_authored_21 TRACK = hashkafa KEY = work_authored_21 }
		}
		else = {
			kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_authored_21 TRACK = parshanut KEY = work_authored_21 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 65 }
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_22 = 2 }
			kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_authored_22 TRACK = talmudics KEY = work_authored_22 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_22 = 3 }
			kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_authored_22 TRACK = hashkafa KEY = work_authored_22 }
		}
		else = {
			kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_authored_22 TRACK = parshanut KEY = work_authored_22 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 66 }
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_23 = 2 }
			kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_authored_23 TRACK = talmudics KEY = work_authored_23 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_23 = 3 }
			kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_authored_23 TRACK = hashkafa KEY = work_authored_23 }
		}
		else = {
			kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_authored_23 TRACK = parshanut KEY = work_authored_23 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 67 }
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_24 = 2 }
			kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_authored_24 TRACK = talmudics KEY = work_authored_24 }

		else_if = {

		}
		else = {
			kehillah_study_specific_work_effect = { WORK = flag:work_authored_24 TRACK = parshanut KEY = work_authored_24 }
		}
	}
}

# Scope: a present student, in the yeshiva tick (scope:kehillah_tick_title,
# scope:kehillah_tick_leader). He masters one work the library holds and he has
# not mastered -- a work of the yeshiva's focus three times as likely, a work
# its standing in his rite makes Classic or better twice as likely.
kehillah_yeshiva_master_a_work_effect = {
	random_list = {
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				scope:kehillah_tick_title = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 2
				scope:kehillah_tick_title = { var:kehillah_yeshiva_specialization ?= flag:parshanut }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 1
				kehillah_lib_standing_work_targum_onkelos >= 8
			}
			kehillah_yeshiva_record_work_effect = { WORK = work_targum_onkelos TRACK = parshanut }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				scope:kehillah_tick_title = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mekhilta } }

# ---- per-work hooks. kehillah_sefer_work_tenets_<flag>_effect: scope the reader,
# after a FIRST mastery. Teaches the tenets the work argues for (vanilla
# knowledge for a playable reader; kehillah_book_tenets for anyone) and nudges
# their popularity in the reader's faith. See section 4.1 of the spec.

	}

# var:kehillah_sefer_fit to 1 when one of his personal tenets is one the work
# argues for, -1 when it is one the work argues against (spec section 4.1).

	if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_24_tenet_b ?= 6 has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_pilpul } set_variable = { name = kehillah_sefer_fit value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_24_tenet_b ?= 7 has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_geonut } set_variable = { name = kehillah_sefer_fit value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_24_tenet_b ?= 8 has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_minhag_avoteinu } set_variable = { name = kehillah_sefer_fit value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_24_tenet_b ?= 9 has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_avelei_tziyon } set_variable = { name = kehillah_sefer_fit value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_24_tenet_b ?= 10 has_personal_tenet = tenet_esotericism } set_variable = { name = kehillah_sefer_fit value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_24_tenet_b ?= 11 has_personal_tenet = tenet_asceticism } set_variable = { name = kehillah_sefer_fit value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_24_tenet_b ?= 12 has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_kiddush_hashem } set_variable = { name = kehillah_sefer_fit value = 1 } }
}

# Scope: none. Named works whose historical date has passed by the start
# of this game (or the first year this save runs the redesign) count as
# written; later ones wait for a scholar's ambition (Daniel, 2026-11-08).
kehillah_sefer_mark_historical_works_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1140
			NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_kuzari_written }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_kuzari_written value = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_kuzari_year value = 1140 }
		kehillah_sefer_ensure_counters_effect = { KEY = work_kuzari }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1100
			NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_written }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_written value = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_year value = 1100 }
		kehillah_sefer_ensure_counters_effect = { KEY = work_rashi_torah }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1100
			NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_talmud_written }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_talmud_written value = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_talmud_year value = 1100 }
		kehillah_sefer_ensure_counters_effect = { KEY = work_rashi_talmud }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1080
			NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_hilkhot_harif_written }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_hilkhot_harif_written value = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_hilkhot_harif_year value = 1080 }
		kehillah_sefer_ensure_counters_effect = { KEY = work_hilkhot_harif }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1180
			NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_mishneh_torah_written }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_mishneh_torah_written value = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_mishneh_torah_year value = 1180 }
		kehillah_sefer_ensure_counters_effect = { KEY = work_mishneh_torah }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1190
			NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_moreh_nevukhim_written }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_moreh_nevukhim_written value = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_moreh_nevukhim_year value = 1190 }
		kehillah_sefer_ensure_counters_effect = { KEY = work_moreh_nevukhim }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1176
			NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_sefer_habahir_written }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_sefer_habahir_written value = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_sefer_habahir_year value = 1176 }
		kehillah_sefer_ensure_counters_effect = { KEY = work_sefer_habahir }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1200
			NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_sefer_hasidim_written }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_sefer_hasidim_written value = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_sefer_hasidim_year value = 1200 }
		kehillah_sefer_ensure_counters_effect = { KEY = work_sefer_hasidim }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1150
			NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_tosafot_written }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_tosafot_written value = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_tosafot_year value = 1150 }
		kehillah_sefer_ensure_counters_effect = { KEY = work_tosafot }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1290
			NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_zohar_written }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_zohar_written value = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = kehillah_wk_work_zohar_year value = 1290 }
		kehillah_sefer_ensure_counters_effect = { KEY = work_zohar }
	}
}

# Scope: a faith. Nudge the popularity of the tenets a work argues for
# ($AMOUNT$ may be negative) -- a Machloket's resolution (section 6.4).
kehillah_sefer_work_popularity_work_targum_onkelos_effect = {
	# argues for no tenet; the argument is still read so every call has one shape
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = kehillah_unused_amount value = $AMOUNT$ }
}
kehillah_sefer_work_popularity_work_mekhilta_effect = {
	# argues for no tenet; the argument is still read so every call has one shape
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = kehillah_unused_amount value = $AMOUNT$ }
}

}
kehillah_sefer_work_popularity_work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer_effect = {
	change_tenet_popularity = { target = tenet:tenet_esotericism change = $AMOUNT$ }
}

# Scope: a champion of the work. Found a rite with its first tenet as core:
# a Machloket's schism, through vanilla's own dynamic rite (section 6.4).
# A work arguing for no tenet cannot split a rite.
kehillah_sefer_work_schism_work_targum_onkelos_effect = {
	# argues for no tenet
}
kehillah_sefer_work_schism_work_mekhilta_effect = {
	# argues for no tenet
}
kehillah_sefer_work_schism_work_genesis_rabbah_effect = {
	# argues for no tenet
}
kehillah_sefer_work_schism_work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer_effect = {
	create_dynamic_rite = {
		save_scope_as = kehillah_schism_rite
		convert = yes
		core_tenet_override_entry = tenet:tenet_esotericism
	}
}

# Scope: the Av Beit Din of a good ruling (kehillah_bet_din_reward_judges_
# for_ruling_effect). He cites one non-canon work he has mastered -- one
# that stands high in his rite more often -- and the court's citation counts
# toward the work's standing once per community (spec section 3.4).
kehillah_sefer_cite_in_ruling_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_mekhilta }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_genesis_rabbah }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_halakhot_gedolot }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_sefer_yetzirah }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_hekhalot_rabbati }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_shiur_qomah }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_sefer_harazim }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_emunot_vedeot }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_chovot_halevavot }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_kuzari }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_tosefta }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_seder_rav_amram }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_iggeret_rav_sherira }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_rabbenu_hananel }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_mekor_hayyim }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_anan_sefer_hamitzvot }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_kitab_alanwar }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_yefet_commentary }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_rashi_torah }

				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_moreh_nevukhim }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_sefer_habahir }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_sefer_hasidim }

				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_01 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_02 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_03 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_04 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_05 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_06 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_07 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_08 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_09 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_10 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_11 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_12 }

				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_15 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_16 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_17 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_18 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_19 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_20 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_21 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_22 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_23 }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_24 }
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } }
				modifier = { add = 2 kehillah_lib_standing_work_targum_onkelos >= 7 }
				modifier = { add = 1 kehillah_lib_genre_work_targum_onkelos = 2 }
				kehillah_sefer_record_citation_effect = { KEY = work_targum_onkelos }
			}
			1 = {

# Scope: the author. Write the named work his ambition chose.
kehillah_sefer_write_named_work_dispatch_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_book_named_work ?= flag:work_kuzari }
		kehillah_sefer_write_named_work_effect = { KEY = work_kuzari }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_book_named_work ?= flag:work_rashi_torah }
		kehillah_sefer_write_named_work_effect = { KEY = work_rashi_torah }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_book_named_work ?= flag:work_rashi_talmud }
		kehillah_sefer_write_named_work_effect = { KEY = work_rashi_talmud }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_book_named_work ?= flag:work_hilkhot_harif }
		kehillah_sefer_write_named_work_effect = { KEY = work_hilkhot_harif }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_book_named_work ?= flag:work_mishneh_torah }
		kehillah_sefer_write_named_work_effect = { KEY = work_mishneh_torah }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_book_named_work ?= flag:work_moreh_nevukhim }
		kehillah_sefer_write_named_work_effect = { KEY = work_moreh_nevukhim }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_book_named_work ?= flag:work_sefer_habahir }
		kehillah_sefer_write_named_work_effect = { KEY = work_sefer_habahir }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_book_named_work ?= flag:work_sefer_hasidim }
		kehillah_sefer_write_named_work_effect = { KEY = work_sefer_hasidim }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_book_named_work ?= flag:work_tosafot }
		kehillah_sefer_write_named_work_effect = { KEY = work_tosafot }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_book_named_work ?= flag:work_zohar }
		kehillah_sefer_write_named_work_effect = { KEY = work_zohar }
	}
}

# Scope: the author of a gloss. The work he glossed gains a commentary.
kehillah_sefer_count_commentary_dispatch_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_book_comment_on ?= flag:work_targum_onkelos }
		kehillah_sefer_bump_counter_effect = { KEY = work_targum_onkelos COUNTER = commentaries } kehillah_standing_add_reception_effect = { KEY = work_targum_onkelos AMOUNT = kehillah_reception_commentary_value }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_book_comment_on ?= flag:work_mekhilta }
		kehillah_sefer_bump_counter_effect = { KEY = work_mekhilta COUNTER = commentaries } kehillah_standing_add_reception_effect = { KEY = work_mekhilta AMOUNT = kehillah_reception_commentary_value }

# Scope: a head of rite. Endorse the work he chose.
kehillah_sefer_endorse_dispatch_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_sefer_named_work ?= flag:work_targum_onkelos }
		kehillah_sefer_endorse_effect = { KEY = work_targum_onkelos }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_sefer_named_work ?= flag:work_mekhilta }
		kehillah_sefer_endorse_effect = { KEY = work_mekhilta }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_sefer_named_work ?= flag:work_genesis_rabbah }
		kehillah_sefer_endorse_effect = { KEY = work_genesis_rabbah }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_sefer_named_work ?= flag:work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer }
		kehillah_sefer_endorse_effect = { KEY = work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_sefer_named_work ?= flag:work_halakhot_gedolot }
		kehillah_sefer_endorse_effect = { KEY = work_halakhot_gedolot }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_sefer_named_work ?= flag:work_sefer_yetzirah }
		kehillah_sefer_endorse_effect = { KEY = work_sefer_yetzirah }

# Scope: the author. Take the first free authored slot; with none free the
# book stays news only (slot recycling is a recorded follow-up).
kehillah_sefer_claim_authored_slot_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_01_written } }
		kehillah_sefer_write_authored_work_effect = { SLOT = work_authored_01 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_02_written } }

		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_15_written } }
		kehillah_sefer_write_authored_work_effect = { SLOT = work_authored_15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_16_written } }
		kehillah_sefer_write_authored_work_effect = { SLOT = work_authored_16 }

	else_if = {

		kehillah_sefer_write_authored_work_effect = { SLOT = work_authored_17 }

	else_if = {

		kehillah_sefer_write_authored_work_effect = { SLOT = work_authored_18 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_19_written } }
		kehillah_sefer_write_authored_work_effect = { SLOT = work_authored_19 }

	else_if = {

		kehillah_sefer_write_authored_work_effect = { SLOT = work_authored_20 }
	}
	else_if = {

# ---- seized books and the ransom pool (section 7.1). Title scope: a
# library whose books are sold off -- every work but the Tanakh enters
# the global pool any Jewish library may redeem from.
kehillah_lib_move_all_to_ransom_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } }
		remove_list_variable = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } } }
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
		}

# Title scope: a library emptied (burned, or given away), Tanakh aside.
kehillah_lib_clear_all_but_tanakh_effect = {
	clear_variable_list = kehillah_library_works
	kehillah_lib_seed_tanakh_effect = yes
	kehillah_lib_refresh_cache_effect = yes
}

# Scope: a library holder. Redeem one seized work his library lacks, a
# missing Bavli order first.
kehillah_lib_redeem_one_effect = {

		limit = { exists = scope:kehillah_redeem_library }

			1 = {
				trigger = {
					is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }

				}
				remove_list_global_variable = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
				scope:kehillah_redeem_library = { add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } kehillah_lib_refresh_cache_effect = yes }
				set_variable = { name = kehillah_sefer_named_work value = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = {

# He brings a copy of one work he mastered that the library lacks, a
# Bavli order more often; nothing if he has none to give.

# Scope: a champion with var:kehillah_sefer_named_work set (event option).
kehillah_sefer_schism_dispatch_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_sefer_named_work ?= flag:work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer }
		kehillah_sefer_work_schism_work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer_effect = yes

	else_if = {

# ---- standing (rite scope). Seed every non-canon work's tier and reception from
# its baseline, inheriting from the faith's main rite when that is already seeded.
kehillah_standing_seed_rite_effect = {
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_targum_onkelos }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_mekhilta }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_genesis_rabbah }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_halakhot_gedolot }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_sefer_yetzirah }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_hekhalot_rabbati }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_shiur_qomah }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_sefer_harazim }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_emunot_vedeot }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_chovot_halevavot }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_tosefta }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_seder_rav_amram }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_iggeret_rav_sherira }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_rabbenu_hananel }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_mekor_hayyim }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_anan_sefer_hamitzvot }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_kitab_alanwar }
	kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_yefet_commentary }
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_standing_ready value = yes }
}

# Rite scope. Seed one written work (named or authored) when it is written.
kehillah_standing_seed_written_works_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_kuzari_written
			NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_standing_work_kuzari }
		}
		kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_kuzari }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_written
			NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_standing_work_rashi_torah }

			has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_19_written
			NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_standing_work_authored_19 }
		}
		kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_authored_19 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_20_written
			NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_standing_work_authored_20 }
		}
		kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_authored_20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_21_written
			NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_standing_work_authored_21 }
		}
		kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_authored_21 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_22_written
			NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_standing_work_authored_22 }
		}
		kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_authored_22 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_23_written
			NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_standing_work_authored_23 }
		}
		kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_authored_23 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_24_written
			NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_standing_work_authored_24 }
		}
		kehillah_standing_seed_work_effect = { KEY = work_authored_24 }

# Title scope (a library). Count its Banned works in its holder's rite into
# var:kehillah_lib_banned_count. Section 4 of Daniel's 2026-11-08 decisions.
kehillah_lib_count_banned_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_banned_count value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = holder }
		holder = { save_scope_as = kehillah_banned_viewer }
		if = {
			limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } scope:kehillah_banned_viewer = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_targum_onkelos <= 1 } }
			change_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_banned_count add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mekhilta } scope:kehillah_banned_viewer = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_mekhilta <= 1 } }
			change_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_banned_count add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_genesis_rabbah } scope:kehillah_banned_viewer = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_genesis_rabbah <= 1 } }
			change_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_banned_count add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer } scope:kehillah_banned_viewer = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer <= 1 } }
			change_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_banned_count add = 1 }
